regions.name: flow_lift_wake
regions.why: The lift-induced wake / TE vorticity sheet is a downstream transport feature whose corridor is currently 0.386% covered. A level-3 box (0.03125 m = half the declared 0.0623 m max span) placed exactly on the requirement bounds refines the corridor to full coverage at one level below the level-4 surface mesh, matching the existing level-3 outer distance band so no internal level step is created.

regions.name: flow_tip_left
regions.why: Left tip-vortex corridor is only 0.18% covered and its declared span (0.04981 m) is the tightest of the three; level 3 gives 0.03125 m, a factor 1.6 below the requirement, and overlaps the wake box so the union is one equal-level block along the vortex path (no transition defect inside the corridor).

regions.name: flow_tip_right
regions.why: Mirror tip-vortex corridor with identical 0.04981 m span requirement; level 3 = 0.03125 m meets it. Spanwise symmetry is preserved exactly (Y bounds mirrored about 0) so the two rolled-up vortices are resolved with equal nominal cell size, which matters because at AR~2 the two vortices interact.

advisor.hypothesis: Measured geometry rules out under-resolution and over-refinement as the driver: the failing cells sit where solid normal half-thickness is p50 0.0263 m (p5 0.0205) while the requested layer stack is 0.018292 m — 70–89% of the local solid half-thickness, i.e. the extrusion column is geometrically oversized, and the native log confirms it (Extruding 51067/75166 = 67.9% of body faces, identical in both outer passes, 'Reducing layer thickness at 0 nodes', 0 truncation lines retained: an all-or-nothing NOEXTRUDE failure, not thickness compression). Non-extruded/downgraded columns adjacent to full 8-layer columns shear into the 236 zero/negative-volume cells, aspect 2.8e95, 1283 misoriented face pyramids and skew 608. Mechanism is therefore total layer thickness vs available wall-normal room, worsened by corner extrusion: 34.3% of adjacent edges exceed feature_angle=60 (dihedral p95 = 90° at the TE/tip creases), so crease columns collide and the medial-axis mover cannot recover them. Fix: reduce installed total thickness by ~22% so the stack fits comfortably under local half-thickness, drop feature_angle to 45 to suppress extrusion at the ~50–90° creases, and raise max_thickness_to_medial_ratio so the medial-distance limiter acts softly before inversion. Keep first height unchanged (0.0011087 m, y+~50 planning surrogate; no sane measured flow, so wall_height is not eligible).
advisor.expected_change: Installed stack falls from 0.018292 m to 0.014724 m (7 layers, ratio 1.13): stack/solid-half-thickness drops from 0.70 to 0.56 at the p50 site and from 0.89 to 0.72 at the p5 site. Native extrusion fraction should rise above 67.9% and coverage_5plus above 0.673, with the 236 zero/negative-volume cells and the 69 skew faces cleared. Off-body corridors already pass natively (p95 span 0.0317 m vs 0.0623/0.0498 m tolerances) and are untouched. Uncertainty: whether the crease suppression plus a 0.022 m transition band is enough to reach 90% 5-layer coverage and pass all six native checks is unverified and must be re-measured.
counterevidence: fluid_gap_metres null and finite_fluid_gap_fraction 0.0 everywhere; directional rays do not prove the region is gap-free, so the fit margin is a sampled estimate only

round-1 and round-2 local_refine level-5 boxes plus snap_smooth at the same site did not remove any of the six native failures (round2 max_skew still 608), so local refinement of the surrounding volume is not the causal mechanism
coverage_5plus is 0.408 in the near-TE region and 0.378 in the trailing region, so this is not a single-box defect — a whole-body layer construction change is needed
native_thickness_truncation retained 0 lines, so no native confirmation exists that thickness was reduced rather than extrusion disabled

coefficient-based y+ is a planning surrogate; the 8-layer stack did achieve p50 y+ 50 in the 54.7% of area that extruded fully, so a shallower stack with a smaller expansion_ratio is as close as we can get without a flow field
alternatives: Swap mesh_shrinker to displacementMotionSolver: the torus counterexample shows changing the shrinker alone is not a general repair, and both outer passes already report identical extrusion counts with the medial-axis mover, so the failure is geometric, not mover-specific

Keep 8 layers at full height but raise max_thickness_to_medial_ratio to 0.6: the stack/solid-half-thickness ratio (0.70-0.89) is the binding constraint and the limiter already reported 'Reducing layer thickness at 0 nodes', so a softer limiter would leave the same collisions
n_grow=1 to propagate non-extrusion: would lower coverage below the already-failing 0.673 rather than fill the uncovered faces
Add level-5 boxes at the two cluster sites: 1.234M cells already exceed 60% of the 2M gate and rounds 1-2 measured no benefit from exactly this

actions.why: Reduce total installed layer thickness to fit the measured solid half-thickness, suppress extrusion at the 90-degree creases that drive the collision, and let the medial-axis limiter act softly. first_layer_thickness is NOT in this patch, so the y+~50 planning first height is preserved.

Smoothed patch normals reduce the spurious dihedral variation that makes the 90-degree creases collide during extrusion; slower feature snapping keeps the level-4 surface mesh (bidirectional p99 8.7e-4 m, tolerance 0.01 m) intact so geometry fidelity is not traded away.

Give the layer columns headroom by keeping the near-wall band uniform and monotone instead of stepping back into the 0.09375 m level-3 band immediately. The 0.022/0.070 m pair interpolates the existing 0.03125/0.09375 m bands: inner distance grows from 2.0x to 1.4x the shallower 0.014724 m stack, so the whole stack lies inside one uniform level-4 region; cells stay flat because the level-3 outer band is retained and end-of-layer transitions have somewhere to land.

Reduce, not add, cells at the two measured failure sites so the level-6 feature_0 box no longer imposes a two-level step on top of the collided layer rows (level 4 -> 6 exceeds the n_cells_between_levels=3 buffer); this is the one change that lowers both the 1.234M cell count and the concave-face population while leaving the passing off-body corridors untouched.
